limitations: Scopes differ: Three walker.step includes walking policy; PlayCanvas engine physicsTime excludes some app input/step assistance.
Final contact points differ; Rapier first wall repetition moved about 0.83 m after warm-up. Same requested input does not guarantee equal collision workload.
FPS differs and cannot be attributed to physics alone; no renderer CPU/GPU profile.
Physics values are submillisecond and page clock resolution is about 0.1 ms.
Three timing dt is clamped to 0.05 seconds; simulated time may differ from wall time.
No controlled process CPU, memory, mobile, power, cold/warm loading, or soak test.
Rapier run snapshots do not include a per-run page-count check; later runs explicitly enforce one page.
